title: Twenty to Four
statement: At 3:40 the hour and minute hands of an analogue clock make two angles. Find the smaller one, in degrees.
hints: The minute hand turns $6^\circ$ per minute.
The hour hand turns $0.5^\circ$ per minute, starting from $90^\circ$ at 3:00.
solution: The minute hand is at $40\times 6^\circ = 240^\circ$ and the hour hand at $90^\circ + 40\times 0.5^\circ = 110^\circ$. They differ by $130^\circ$, which is already under $180^\circ$.
